source_name: LMFDB number fields — canonical defining polynomials

official_access.deterministic_query: SELECT label, coeffs, degree, disc_abs, disc_sign, galois_label FROM nf_fields ORDER BY label

scope.derived_structure: P(x)=0 from the stored constant-first defining-polynomial coefficients
scope.reason: The database attests the coefficient vector for the defining polynomial; the Atlas serializes those coefficients into an equation P(x)=0 and therefore does not claim the emitted notation is the source's original notation.

snapshot_policy.rule: Export the selected columns in deterministic label order, compute SHA-256 over the exact CSV byte stream before extraction, and identify the acquisition as rowstream-sha256:<digest>. A wall-clock date or LMFDB release label alone is not sufficient because the public mirror can change independently.

license_policy.rule: Preserve LMFDB attribution and share-alike metadata with every published Parquet snapshot and Internet Archive item; do not assert a CC-BY-SA version that the official access page does not specify.
